expectations.text: Treats coverage and project fit as two separate value axes that can disagree, rather than one blended measure of a mechanic's quality
expectations.evidence: The transcript names both problems separately. Coverage is point 1 (16 rounds reach about 18% of the room). Project fit is point 2 (only 6 projects, so cold pairs have nothing to build). The 'Keep a small mixer' section also hints at a split by keeping networking ('If you still want networking') apart from team formation. But both points are listed as reasons the mixer 'fails', which reads as one blended verdict. The transcript never says outright that a mechanic can score well on one axis and badly on the other.
